scope: Exact fixed-optimum OU corollary for the paleoTS joint time-series likelihood; second-paper branch only.

implementation_contract.process_covariance: exp(-alpha |t-s|) min(V(s),V(t)), V(t)=vstep(1-exp(-2 alpha t))/(2 alpha)
implementation_contract.relationship_to_existing_theorem: exact v_optimum=0 boundary of the evoTS OUBM observation law

semantic_boundary.hard_stop: Do not claim that the observed OU half-life or expected halfway time is numerically wrong. The result targets mechanistic one-way attribution of alpha.

empirical_anchors.citation: Hunt G, Bell MA, Travis MP. 2008. Evolution toward a new adaptive optimum: phenotypic evolution in a fossil stickleback lineage. Evolution 62:700-710.
empirical_anchors.practice: Interprets alpha as restraining force/stabilizing selection and reports half-lives of about 580-853 generations.

empirical_anchors.citation: Lo Cascio Saetre C et al. 2017. Rapid adaptive phenotypic change following colonization of a newly restored habitat. Nature Communications 8:14159.
empirical_anchors.practice: Explicitly uses PaleoTS, interprets alpha as restraining force and reports half-life 1.76 years as exceptionally rapid adaptation.

concede: phylogenetic OU half-life interpretation and cautions
warning that positive alpha need not alone prove stabilizing selection
prior_art_ceiling.candidate_increment: implementation-matched paleoTS time-series equality plus exact alpha=a+d causal decomposition and separation of descriptive relaxation from direct mechanistic attraction
